label: assertion
text: Winning-ticket initializations discovered by iterative magnitude pruning on large, complex natural-image source datasets produce sparse initializations that, when used to train a VGG19 or ResNet50 architecture on other natural-image target datasets , frequently achieve test accuracies on the target tasks that are close to the accuracies obtained by winning tickets discovered directly on those target datasets.
完整表述: Winning-ticket initializations discovered by iterative magnitude pruning on large, complex natural-image source datasets produce sparse initializations that, when used to train a VGG19 or ResNet50 architecture on other natural-image target datasets, frequently achieve test accuracies on the target tasks that are close to the accuracies obtained by winning tickets discovered directly on those target datasets.

label: assertion
text: The transferability is observed across a wide range of pruning fractions
完整表述: The transferability described in 【1】 is observed across a wide range of pruning fractions, including very high sparsity.
完整表述_不含instance: The transferability described in 【1】 is observed across a wide range of pruning fractions.

label: assertion
text: larger / more class-rich source datasets produced stronger cross-dataset transfer than smaller sources
完整表述: Larger / more class-rich source datasets produced stronger cross-dataset transfer than smaller sources.

label: example
text: (CIFAR-100 tickets generalize better than CIFAR-10 tickets despite both having 50,000 training examples).
完整表述: CIFAR-100 tickets generalize better than CIFAR-10 tickets despite both having 50,000 training examples.
完整表述_不含instance: CIFAR-100 tickets generalize better than CIFAR-10 tickets despite both having 50,000 training examples.

label: assertion
text: Winning tickets discovered on larger source datasets transfer substantially better to other natural-image classification datasets than tickets discovered on smaller source datasets, for both VGG19 and ResNet50 architectures.
完整表述: Winning tickets discovered on larger source datasets—both in terms of number of training examples and number of output classes—transfer substantially better to other natural-image classification datasets (SVHN, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet, Places365) than tickets discovered on smaller source datasets, for both VGG19 and ResNet50 architectures.
完整表述_不含instance: Winning tickets discovered on larger source datasets—both in terms of number of training examples and number of output classes—transfer substantially better to other natural-image classification datasets than tickets discovered on smaller source datasets, for both VGG19 and ResNet50 architectures.

label: assertion
text: This effect is not solely explained by raw training-set size:
完整表述: The effect described in 【1】, whereby winning tickets discovered on larger source datasets transfer substantially better to other natural-image classification datasets than tickets discovered on smaller source datasets, is not solely explained by raw training-set size.

label: 论据
text: holding training-set size fixed, a source dataset with many classes produced tickets that generalized better across targets than one with few classes
完整表述: Holding training-set size fixed, a source dataset with many classes (CIFAR-100, 100 classes) produced tickets that generalized better across targets than one with few classes (CIFAR-10, 10 classes).
完整表述_不含instance: Holding training-set size fixed, a source dataset with many classes produced tickets that generalized better across targets than one with few classes.

label: assertion
text: Winning-ticket initializations generated with one optimizer generalize to training with a different optimizer on natural-image classification datasets:
完整表述: Winning-ticket initializations generated with one optimizer generalize to training with a different optimizer on natural-image classification datasets.

label: example
text: VGG19 tickets found using SGD with momentum or using Adam, when re-used with the alternate optimizer, achieve high performance that is comparable to tickets discovered under the target optimizer.
完整表述: VGG19 tickets found using SGD with momentum or using Adam, when re-used with the alternate optimizer, achieve high performance that is comparable to tickets discovered under the target optimizer.

label: assertion
text: There are optimizer-dependent nuances in behavior:
完整表述: There are optimizer-dependent nuances in behavior in the transfer described in 【1】.

label: 论据
text: tickets transferred from SGD to Adam sometimes under-perform random tickets at low pruning fractions but outperform random tickets at high pruning fractions.
完整表述: Tickets transferred from SGD to Adam sometimes under-perform random tickets at low pruning fractions but outperform random tickets at high pruning fractions.

label: assertion
text: A winning ticket discovered on CIFAR-10a, transfers to a disjoint subset CIFAR-10b from the same data distribution and improves training on that held-out subset relative to random sparse initializations.
完整表述: A winning ticket discovered on CIFAR-10a (a subset of the CIFAR-10 dataset containing 25,000 training images with 2,500 images per class), transfers to a disjoint subset CIFAR-10b from the same data distribution and improves training on that held-out subset relative to random sparse initializations.

label: assertion
text: This within-distribution transfer holds for both VGG19 and ResNet50
完整表述: The within-distribution transfer described in 【1】 holds for both VGG19 and ResNet50.

label: assertion
text: ResNet50 showed sensitivity at low pruning fractions
完整表述: ResNet50 showed sensitivity at low pruning fractions, occasionally under-performing random tickets when few weights are pruned.

label: assertion
text: When performing magnitude pruning for winning-ticket discovery on VGG19 trained on CIFAR-10, globally ranking weights across all layers and pruning the smallest-magnitude weights globally yields higher-performing sparse subnetworks than pruning a fixed fraction per layer
完整表述: When performing magnitude pruning for winning-ticket discovery on VGG19 trained on CIFAR-10, globally ranking weights across all layers and pruning the smallest-magnitude weights globally yields higher-performing sparse subnetworks than pruning a fixed fraction per layer.

label: 论据
text: Under global magnitude pruning the pruning fractions vary across layers: deeper convolutional layers are pruned more heavily while early layers retain a much larger fraction of their parameters.
完整表述: Under global magnitude pruning the pruning fractions vary across layers: deeper convolutional layers are pruned more heavily while early layers retain a much larger fraction of their parameters.

label: assertion
text: For VGG19 trained on CIFAR-10, the structure of the pruning mask contains substantial information useful for training sparse networks:
完整表述: For VGG19 trained on CIFAR-10, the structure of the pruning mask contains substantial information useful for training sparse networks.

label: 论据
text: comparing (a) preserved winning-ticket masks, (b) masks permuted only within layers , and (c) masks permuted across all layers shows that locally permuting a mask degrades performance moderately while globally permuting the mask degrades performance dramatically.
完整表述: Comparing (a) preserved winning-ticket masks, (b) masks permuted only within layers (local permutation), and (c) masks permuted across all layers (global permutation) shows that locally permuting a mask degrades performance moderately while globally permuting the mask degrades performance dramatically.

label: assertion
text: a fair "random ticket" baseline for evaluating a winning-ticket initialization should randomize both weight values and mask structure
完整表述: A fair "random ticket" baseline for evaluating a winning-ticket initialization should randomize both weight values and mask structure (global permutation).

label: assertion
text: an iterative magnitude-pruning schedule with pruning fraction per iteration 0.2 over up to 30 iterations combined with late resetting to parameters at a small early training iteration produced effective winning tickets
完整表述: For obtaining competitive winning tickets in the large-model and large-dataset regime of natural-image classification, an iterative magnitude-pruning schedule with pruning fraction per iteration 0.2 (20% of remaining parameters) over up to 30 iterations combined with late resetting to parameters at a small early training iteration—resetting to the parameters after 1 epoch for Fashion-MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and after 3 epochs for ImageNet and Places365—produced effective winning tickets, with learning-rate annealing schedules and other hyperparameters matched per model family.
